name: Deputy Lindqvist
blurb: A soft-spoken county deputy who never raises his voice and never stops writing.

look.description: A county deputy in a green rain jacket with the hood out, a white helmet and a flashlight on her belt.

meta.notes: The region's local cop (region-pnw, playtest 1c), with Sgt. Pruitt's starting numbers. Sample line (agent draft): "I'm not upset. I'm just writing it all down." He carries the taser (the cops polish round, 2026-10-01: each region's cop is armed, per M4 cops-3; the quiet weapon for the quiet deputy), so you can snatch it off him mid-swing. [default] Run W-T (law with a personality): his habit is `citations`. He never rams: alongside he rides 1.5 m off you, out of bumping range (his taser still reaches). Every 3 s alongside he writes a $75 citation, and the total is billed at your finish (the career charges it). He moves in after 3 s on station and stays alongside 12 s. [default]
